crossRefs.note: The couriers went out in haste by the king’s commandment, and the decree was given out in the citadel of Susa. The king…
Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters to all the Jews who were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both…
He wrote in the name of King Ahasuerus, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by courier on horseback…

people.name: Esther
people.line: Jewish queen of Persia; saved her people from genocide.

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority to confirm this second letter of Purim.
translations.bsb: So Queen Esther daughter of Abihail, along with Mordecai the Jew, wrote with full authority to confirm this second letter concerning Purim.
translations.kjv: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.
translations.asv: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority to confirm this second letter of Purim.
